about_the_game:
Long Live My Lady! - is the story of a dwarf who runs the only tavern in the Dungeon. The tavern was once run by his landlady, but now she has fallen into a deep slumber. Bring the tavern back to its former glory, rebuild it, create items, cook food, run errands for the locals and of course brew beer!

Furnish the tavern to your liking

It's been a long time since the last customer left the tavern. The tavern has fallen into disrepair. Create interior and decorative items and furnish it as you wish! Decorative items have a positive effect on the visitors and who knows, maybe they will look at this beautiful statue and leave a good review of your place!

Serve your tavern visitors

Your guests expect you to serve them to the highest standard. Serve them a glass of cold beer or a plate of delicious stew. But be careful, visitors won't like it if you stay in the kitchen too long or don't keep an eye on your tavern. Follow proper time management and plan ahead. And remember - the customer is always right!

Complete your tasks

The duties of a tavern owner include more than just brewing beer. Talk to the visitors and explore the tavern's surroundings. This is a great way to find a couple or two quests that will lead you to new discoveries!

Farm and cook your meals

There's nothing better than a good beer appetizer. Grow vegetables and plants to make dishes that even the pickiest of diners will enjoy. And fishing and livestock farming are a great way to diversify your menu!

Combine recipes with additional ingredients

Who says you can't diversify your dishes a little? After all, no one can see what you're doing in your kitchen. Add extra ingredients to your recipes to achieve new effects. Maybe you have a picky customer who is always dissatisfied with something? Pour a spell potion into his beer and he'll leave satisfied no matter what. Or maybe he has something you want. Add sleeping pills to his food and rummage through his pockets while he sleeps. Find additional ingredients and study their effects on your customers!

Take care of your princess

The princess is long asleep, but her spirit is still with you. Present her with gifts to keep her awake, and in gratitude she will help you expand and improve the tavern. But be careful - your mistress will not tolerate mistakes, and if you disappoint her, you won't get away with it so easily.

short_description: A lone gnome, a sleeping princess and a sea of beer. Take care of your mistress by becoming the manager of the only tavern in the entire Dungeon!
